all 1825 theorems: hypotheses equal the form expected from the ledger kind and scope (NOT_IN_IDEAL(1) -> [IsAlgClosed K]; NONEMPTY -> none; characteristic p -> [CharP K p], p prime; char0 -> [CharZero K]; outside S -> ringChar K not in S, S prime, sorted, equal to ledger); every claim held (last op support); labels, keys and manifest scopes agree with the ledger
all 1815 matroid claims: Lean lines and Fin n equal the matroid file; current encoder digest and system equal the claim's bound encoding; the encoder's validation (simple, rank 3) passes
all 10 source claims: the Lean polynomial equals the ledger one-variable system, which has no guards
supplementary full read (outside the sample, which drew no source or map-s claim): Source000 (10) and MapOut000 (9) read in full; no issue
for_will: NOT_IN_IDEAL(1) is stated as "for every algebraically closed K of the scope"; GP-CLI says "a point over the algebraic closure". These are equivalent (ACF_p complete) and the Lean form is the stronger, so it is not a defect; noted so the reading is explicit.

The challenges state matroid realizability directly, so a Comparator pass certifies the meaning without relying on ENCODING-FRAME; CATALOG-COMPLETE and the trusted catalog generator bear on coverage of chi, not on any single statement.

Faithfulness of RealizesRank3 to "realizes M" relies on the line data being a simple rank-3 linear space; the encoder enforces this, and the whole-set check confirms it for every emitted matroid claim.
